caption: Leaning Tower of Pisa, Pisa
composition: Floodlit leaning campanile on Piazza dei Miracoli at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The visitor faces the Piazza dei Miracoli at night, where the floodlit Leaning Tower rises left of center, its white arcaded tiers glowing against the dark sky. The cathedral stretches across the middle ground with its long nave and dome, and the baptistery's dome appears at the far right edge. Warm floodlights pick out every arch and column, with the green lawn dark in the foreground and a few clouds drifting overhead.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Leaning Tower of Pisa floodlit at night on Piazza dei Miracoli
